title: Field-extension Frobenius compatibility
statement: The canonical scalar-extension comparisons to finite coefficient fields and the algebraic closure intertwine the signed Tate-twist Frobenius operators.

source.place: (1.1.7), pp. 150-151; decomposition of the scalar-action and coefficient-comparison clauses of lem-pur-twist-frobenius-scalar

proof.text: The finite-field and common-stage cohomology comparisons scalarRationalH and scalarQbarH are composites of components of natural isomorphisms and images of isomorphisms under homology. Thus the specified comparison maps themselves are invertible; no choice of generators or replacement comparison is required.

Use the rational scalar clause of lem-pur-twist-frobenius-scalar-rational-qbar at E and at every finite coefficient field L, and its common-stage scalar clause at Ω. A field homomorphism sends the displayed signed scalar q^(-m) to the corresponding target scalar, since it preserves natural casts, inverses and powers. On the generating tensors 1 tensor x, the scalar-extension functor sends f to 1 tensor f(x); the balancing relation and linearity of the comparison identify this with the target scalar times the image of 1 tensor x. The scalar formula for the target operator gives the intertwining equation. Tensor generation gives equality of the two module morphisms.
